searchText: Vitalik, thanks for explanation! On the last call <@!203220829473996800> confirmed that this case may affect liveness, though not sure I got details on that. I have another question : `Block import -> process_attestation -> update_pending_votes` has the following condition check: ```py assert pending_header.slot == attestation.data.slot ``` Does it mean that all `ShardHeader` attestations should be made on the same slot as this `ShardHeader` ? And no more attestations could be produced for this `ShardHeader` at later slots?

excerpts.content:
I have another question : 

`Block import -> process_attestation -> update_pending_votes` has the following condition check: 
```py
assert pending_header.slot == attestation.data.slot
```
Does it mean that all `ShardHeader` attestations should be made on the same slot as this `ShardHeader` ? 
And no more attestations could be produced for this `ShardHeader` at later slots?
